definitions.explanation: A condition where blood pressure in the arteries is persistently elevated, increasing the risk of heart disease and stroke.

examples.japanese: {高血圧|こうけつあつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{生活習慣病|せいかつしゅうかんびょう}→生活習慣病：08620_seikatsushuukanbyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: High blood pressure is one of the lifestyle diseases.

examples.japanese: ⟦{塩分|えんぶん}→塩分：09945_enbun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{取|と}り→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦{過|す}ぎ→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{高血圧|こうけつあつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Excessive salt intake can cause high blood pressure.

examples.japanese: {高血圧|こうけつあつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{飲|の}んでいる→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: I take high blood pressure medication every day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦{診断|しんだん}→診断：04209_shindan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{高血圧|こうけつあつ}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: I was told I have high blood pressure at my health checkup.

examples.japanese: {高血圧|こうけつあつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自覚|じかく}→自覚：05319_jikaku⟧⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{定期的|ていきてき}→定期的：06173_teikiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{血圧|けつあつ}→血圧：00218_ketsuatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: High blood pressure often has no noticeable symptoms, so it's important to measure your blood pressure regularly.

notes:
{高血圧|こうけつあつ} refers to high blood pressure (hypertension).

Related terms:
- ⟦{血圧|けつあつ}→血圧：00218_ketsuatsu⟧ (blood pressure)
- ⟦{低血圧|ていけつあつ}→低血圧：07103_teiketsuatsu⟧ (low blood pressure)
- ⟦{最高血圧|さいこうけつあつ}→最高血圧：noentry⟧/⟦{収縮期血圧|しゅうしゅくきけつあつ}→収縮期血圧：noentry⟧ (systolic pressure)
- ⟦{最低血圧|さいていけつあつ}→最低血圧：noentry⟧/⟦{拡張期血圧|かくちょうきけつあつ}→拡張期血圧：noentry⟧ (diastolic pressure)

Common expressions:
- {高血圧|こうけつあつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧ (treatment of hypertension)
- ⟦{血圧|けつあつ}→血圧：00218_ketsuatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧ (to measure blood pressure)
- ⟦{血圧|けつあつ}→血圧：00218_ketsuatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ (to have high blood pressure)

Note:
{高血圧|こうけつあつ} is called "silent killer" because it often has no symptoms but increases the risk of stroke (⟦{脳卒中|のうそっちゅう}→脳卒中：04647_nousocchuu⟧) and heart disease (⟦{心臓病|しんぞうびょう}→心臓病：04418_shinzoubyou⟧). Japan has many public blood pressure monitors in pharmacies and community centers.
